title: Reconcile event streams Ch 36 vs Ch 47-52
description: 11-event-streams vs 16-interop-streams: WebSocket preferred vs ruled out; resume vs no replay; same path GET /corundum/v1/events; OAuth mention vs client API out of scope. Heartbeat sequence numbers; filtered gaps break gap detection; global sequence needs visibility-after-commit rule; state at-least-once + idempotent receivers; since=0 head vs start-of-log; verify tombstones and key-rotated against signed objects; per-event signatures SHOULD vs MUST; long-lived stream outlives key revocation; block.created event leaks blocks; eventStream missing from capabilities; event names key on IPNS (fine under D1). Decide whether client stream (Ch 36) stays in scope.
